author: ItzAidan
body:
Hey guys just to summarize this question, (This is a question for map developers but if you know the answer thats fine too!)
Okay well I've heard from people that tetris plains had a couple bugs that needed to be fixed. Well that was a couple months ago and I'm wondering if its coming back, when its coming back, and did it get taken down because people didn't like it? Those are my questions and if you could answer that, that would be great! I personally really liked that map and was wondering if its coming back. I really hope it is.
Thanks!
